newsitem.title: UK: EIU sees firmer wool price in 1998.
newsitem.headline: EIU sees firmer wool price in 1998.

text.p: The Economist Intelligence Unit (EIU) predicts that depletion of the Australian stockpile will benefit wool prices in 1998.
"As the Australian wool stockpile continues to decrease, demand will begin to catch up with supply", says the latest EIU World Commodity Forecasts.
It looks for a likely lift for prices of apparel wool to at least 700 Australian cents/kg clean basis (Eastern Market Indicator) in 1998.
The EIU sees consumption rising 2.0 percent in 1996/97 although it adds that demand in China, the largest consumer, is difficult to guage.
It says Chinese exports of apparel products fell significantly in 1996 and domestic consumption rose slowly.
